messages:
elaine: Quick design review — trying a compact row layout + a new 'performance heatmap' column that shows P95 latency variance across models. Also exploring a 'version lock' icon that pins a model when you hover. Screenshot attached. :eyes:

sam: Heatmap is a nice signal. Concern: colors alone won't work for colorblind users and might be noisy at 12px row height. Can we add a numeric tooltip on hover and make it sortable? :question:

vivian: +1 on tooltip. Suggest hatch overlay for extreme outliers (>2σ) so the map is still legible in mono viewing or print. Microcopy: change the tooltip label from 'Lock' to 'Version lock' for clarity when people scan quickly.

mike: Row density tradeoff: compact rows give more results above the fold but break keyboard target sizes. If we keep compact, we should increase actionable hit areas to 44px while keeping the visual line-height tight. Also we need a visible focus state — outline-offset: 2px; fallback box-shadow.

designbot: a11y-scan: contrast warning on dark theme for low-value heatmap color (#3a3a3a on #0f0f0f) — fails AA. Recommend either shift palette or add patterning. Also flagged missing aria-label on the version-lock button in the prototype.

elaine: Good points. Action items: (1) viv to mock hatch + numeric tooltip, (2) mike to prototype focus/hit-area change, (3) sam to run sorting + keyboard nav flows and check scannability. I'll update the spec with interaction states. Anyone want to take the compare-modal header copy?

vivian: I can take copy. Suggest: 'Compare models — performance & stability' instead of plain 'Compare models' so the intent is explicit. :sparkles:

sam: Also propose an opt-in 'Compact mode' toggle in the table header (top-right). Persist choice in localStorage and surface a small toast the first time it switches so users know it only affects density.

mike: For version-lock interaction, avoid ambiguous verbs. Tooltip suggestion: 'Lock to this model version for comparisons (toggle)'. Use aria-pressed on the control and make the pressed state persist in the compare flow.

vivian: Quick aria snippet for the lock button: 
``
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Lock model version 1.2.0">
  🔒
</button>
```

elaine: Thanks all — I'll fold these into the spec and schedule a short sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review mocks and accessibility checks. :calendar:
